meta.name: using-superpowers
meta.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions

copy.tagline: 学会在每次回应前先调用对应技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次对话开始都想按规范调用技能
copy.tagline_en: Learn to call the right skill before every response
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish proper skill usage at the start of any conversation

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在回应或动手前会先判断有没有对应的“技能”(预设处理步骤),有就一定要先调用;使用前会宣布“Using [技能名]”,再严格照做。多个技能并存时,先流程类后实现类。
howto.when: 每个会话一开始就生效;Claude 觉得可能沾边(哪怕 1%)就得在回复或动手前先调用,包括澄清问题前;实际不适用可不用。进计划模式前若还没头脑风暴,会先调用 brainstorming。

say.text: 我们来做一个待办事项 App。
say.note: 触发 brainstorming,先厘清需求再实现。

say.text: 修一下这个按钮点击没反应的问题。
先看看这个项目的结构,再给我优化建议。
say.note: Claude 会先查有没有适用技能,再按其指引探索。

howto.what_en: Claude checks for applicable skills before replying or acting. If any might apply (even 1%), it must invoke it, announce 'Using [skill]' and follow it. Process skills run before implementation; user instructions override skills.
howto.when_en: At conversation start; anytime a skill might apply (even 1%). Skills invoke before ANY response or action (skippable if inapplicable). Brainstorming runs before plan mode if not done yet.

say_en.text: Let's build a todo list app.
say_en.note: Triggers brainstorming to clarify requirements first.

say_en.text: Fix the button that doesn't respond when clicked.
say_en.note: Runs systematic-debugging to find the root cause.

say_en.text: Look at this project's structure and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Claude checks skills first, then explores accordingly.
